placements.title: Verification of system behavior through testing
placements.frame: What claims about system behavior are being verified, and through what instruments?

placements.title: System artifacts become instruments for verifying their own behavior
placements.frame: How does the system use its own artifacts as self-referential test instruments to carry and verify assertions about its behavioral rules?
placements.why: Both segments cohere under a single thematic subject: the pipeline's own vocabulary and artifacts serve as test instruments for verifying the pipeline's own behavior. src-1 performs the decision that the e2e suite asserts a behavioral rule — saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer — while src-2 subordinates the probe memory's entire existence to carrying that assertion. This is not a one-time measurement but a recurring subject: the practice of using system artifacts as self-referential test instruments. Future envelopes feeding probe memories or self-referential assertions would accumulate here.
